[color=#7f6000][size=5][b]ABOUT[/b][/size][/color]

[b][color=#6aa84f]Automate Smart Input (ASI)[/color][/b]
 expands Pathoschild's Automate with smarter production decisions,
farm planning, storage management and an in-game dashboard.

ASI is built to reduce repetitive farm management
while keeping the player in control.



[color=#bf9000][size=4][b]WHAT ASI HELPS YOU DO[/b][/size][/color]

🌱 [b]Plan your crops[/b] and decide what to plant next

⚙️ [b]Choose better machine inputs[/b] for supported production

🛡️ [b]Protect important items[/b] with minimum stock levels

⭐ [b]Protect and automatically stage bundle items[/b] for the Community Center

📦 [b]Give your chests clear roles[/b] for production and storage

🌾 [b]Monitor your crops[/b] — ready, unwatered and upcoming harvests

💰 [b]Track production value[/b] and see what your machines are adding



[quote][b][color=#93c47d]Reduce busywork without taking control away from the player.[/color][/b]

If ASI isn't confident about something,
it leaves it alone and lets normal Automate behavior handle it.[/quote][line]


[color=#7f6000][size=5][b]MAIN FEATURES[/b][/size][/color]


[line]


[size=4][b]🌱 [color=#bf9000]FARM PLANNING[/color][/b][/size]

[i]Plan around the farm you actually have.[/i]

[b]Planting space[/b] • Season • Remaining growing time

[b]Seeds[/b] • Available money • Sprinkler coverage

[b]Production value[/b] • Protected stock • Community Center needs

[b]Crop preferences[/b] • Minimums • Maximums • Preferred crops


[quote]ASI can combine those factors into a clear recommendation such as:

[color=#93c47d][size=4][b]Plant 5× Aloe today[/b][/size][/color][/quote]When suitable placement can be determined safely,
ASI can also highlight the planned planting spots directly on your farm.


[line]


[size=4][b]🌾 [color=#bf9000]CROP OVERVIEW[/color][/b][/size]

[i]See your current fields at a glance.[/i]

[b]Plants[/b] • Ready to harvest • Unwatered

[b]Fertilized[/b] • Expected harvest value

[b]Ready-harvest value[/b] • Estimated next harvest

[b]Individual crops[/b] • Timing • Quantity • Value

No more walking across the whole farm
just to figure out what's ready.


[line]


[size=4][b]⚙️ [color=#bf9000]LIVE PRODUCTION[/color][/b][/size]

[i]See what your Automate machines are doing right now.[/i]

[b]Running machines[/b] • Finished machines

[b]Current output value[/b] • Produced items

[b]Quantity[/b] • Remaining processing time

[b]Next batch[/b] • Time until ready

Especially useful once your farm has
dozens or hundreds of machines running at once.


[line]


[size=4][b]💰 [color=#bf9000]PRODUCTION STATISTICS[/color][/b][/size]

[i]See what your production is actually adding to your farm.[/i]

[size=4][b]Input Value • Output Value • Added Value[/b][/size]

[b]By machine[/b] • By input • Production history

See which machines and production chains
are actually creating the most value.


[line]


[size=4][b]🧠 [color=#bf9000]SMARTER MACHINE INPUT[/color][/b][/size]

[i]Help Automate make better production choices.[/i]

For supported machines, ASI can consider
the available inputs and their value before processing them.

This can help prevent a valuable ingredient from being consumed
when another valid input would make more sense.

[b]OFF[/b]
Normal Automate behavior only.

[b]CHECK ONLY[/b]
ASI evaluates better choices without steering machine input.

[b]ACTIVE[/b]
ASI may apply supported production choices automatically.


[line]


[size=4][b]📦 [color=#bf9000]SMART STORAGE[/color][/b][/size]

[i]Turn connected chests into a real production warehouse.[/i]

[b]Stored items[/b] • Item types • Storage value

[b]Quantity[/b] • Unit value • Total value

ASI can distinguish between normal production stock,
protected stock and supported finished goods.


[line]


[size=4][b]🛡️ [color=#bf9000]KEEP RESERVE[/color][/b][/size]

[i]Protect important resources with minimum stock levels.[/i]

Tell ASI how many of an item
should always remain untouched.


[quote][b]Examples[/b]

Keep [b]100 Wood[/b]

Keep [b]50 Coal[/b]

Keep [b]20 Seeds[/b]

Protect cooking, crafting or quest resources[/quote]Only stock [b]above[/b] your protected minimum
becomes available for normal ASI production decisions.

Reserve amounts can be managed directly
through the in-game [b]Keep Reserve[/b] window.


[line]


[size=4][b]📦 [color=#bf9000]CHEST NETWORK & ROLES[/color][/b][/size]

[i]Decide what each chest should be used for.[/i]

ASI detects connected chests
and lets you manage their role directly in game.

[size=4][b]MANAGED[/b][/size]
Normal ASI-managed production storage.

[size=4][b]FINAL GOODS[/b][/size]
Storage intended for finished products.

[size=4][b]UNMANAGED[/b][/size]
A chest ASI should leave alone.

[b]Machine Input[/b] • Machine Output • Smart Out

[b]Automatic Sorting[/b] • Community Center staging


[line]


[size=4][b]🎨 [color=#bf9000]CHEST SKINS[/color][/b][/size]

[i]Make chest roles visible directly on your farm.[/i]

[b]Managed[/b] • Final Goods • Unmanaged

[b]Off[/b] • Per Chest • All

Chest skins are optional and purely visual.
They can be disabled whenever you want.


[line]


[size=4][b]👀 [color=#bf9000]CHEST PREVIEW[/color][/b][/size]

[i]See what's inside without opening the chest.[/i]

[b]Chest role[/b] • Used slots • Compact item preview

Hover over a supported chest
to quickly see what's stored inside.

Especially useful once your farm
has a large storage network.


[line]


[size=4][b]⭐ [color=#bf9000]COMMUNITY CENTER SUPPORT[/color][/b][/size]

[i]Protect bundle items — and let ASI help organize them.[/i]

ASI reads supported Community Center requirements
from your actual save.

[b]Protect required bundle items[/b]

[b]Consider seasonal crop deadlines[/b]

[b]Prevent needed items from being processed too early[/b]

[b]Avoid using the same stock for competing goals[/b]

[b]Designate a Community Center staging chest[/b]

[b]Automatically place supported required bundle items
into the chest you marked for Community Center use[/b]


[quote][b]Your bundle items don't have to disappear into production
just because Automate can use them.[/b][/quote]Bundle staging stays inside normal connected
storage and Automate network rules.

ASI does not teleport items between disconnected networks.


[line]


[size=4][b]🌱 [color=#bf9000]CROP PREFERENCES[/color][/b][/size]

[i]Tell the Farm Planner what you actually want to grow.[/i]

[b]Minimum amount[/b] • Maximum amount

[b]Prefer when equally profitable[/b]

[b]Do not plant new[/b]

[b]Community Center season protection[/b]

Existing crops are not removed
simply because you change a planning preference.


[line]


[color=#7f6000][size=5][b]ONE DASHBOARD FOR THE WHOLE FARM[/b][/size][/color]

Press [b]F10[/b] to open Automate Smart Input.

[size=4][b]Planning • Crops • Live[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Storage • Chests • Statistics[/b][/size]

Most everyday ASI features can now be managed
directly in game without manually editing configuration files.


[line]


[color=#7f6000][size=5][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size][/color]

[size=4][b]REQUIRED[/b][/size]

[b]Stardew Valley[/b] 1.6.15

[b]SMAPI[/b] 4.1.10 or later

[b]Automate[/b] 2.6.1 by Pathoschild


[color=#bf9000][size=4][b]OPTIONAL[/b][/size][/color]

[b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]

GMCM is not required.

ASI works normally without it.


[line]


[color=#7f6000][size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size][/color]

[b]1.[/b] Install SMAPI.

[b]2.[/b] Install Automate.

[b]3.[/b] Download Automate Smart Input.

[b]4.[/b] Extract the [b]AutomateSmartInput[/b] folder
into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.

[b]5.[/b] Start Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

[b]6.[/b] Press [b]F10[/b] to open the ASI dashboard.


[line]


[color=#7f6000][size=5][b]UPDATING[/b][/size][/color]

Close Stardew Valley before updating.

Replace the old [b]AutomateSmartInput[/b] folder
with the new release folder.

The release archive does not contain [b]config.json[/b],
so your existing settings should remain untouched.


[line]


[color=#7f6000][size=5][b]UNINSTALLING[/b][/size][/color]

Close Stardew Valley and remove
the [b]AutomateSmartInput[/b] folder from your Mods folder.

Removing ASI does not remove Automate.


[line]


[color=#7f6000][size=5][b]BETA / KNOWN LIMITATIONS[/b][/size][/color]


[quote][b]This is the first public beta release.[/b]

ASI has been tested extensively,
but public players will inevitably find mod combinations
and edge cases we haven't seen yet.[/quote][b]•[/b] Full Host/Farmhand multiplayer runtime testing is not yet complete.

[b]•[/b] Some highly custom or random-output mod machines are intentionally unsupported.

[b]•[/b] Cask support exists but still has limited real runtime testing.

[b]•[/b] ASI does not claim support for every machine from every mod.

[b]•[/b] When ASI cannot confidently understand something,
it leaves that behavior to normal Automate.


[quote][size=4][b]Doing nothing is better than making a bad automatic decision.[/b][/size][/quote][line]


[color=#7f6000][size=5][b]BUG REPORTS[/b][/size][/color]

If something goes wrong, please include:

[b]•[/b] Your exact Automate Smart Input version

[b]•[/b] A link to your SMAPI log

[b]•[/b] What you expected to happen

[b]•[/b] What actually happened

[b]•[/b] Short reproduction steps

[b]•[/b] Relevant machine or content mods

Please don't post save files, personal file paths,
account information or other private data
unless it is genuinely necessary.
